content: {"summary":"On 26 March 2025 the search‑api‑02 service began logging SRCH‑E502 errors from 12:30 UTC to 13:00 UTC. The errors were caused by the thread‑pools on search‑cluster‑02 and search‑cluster‑03 becoming full and refusing new queries, a condition triggered by an unexplained rise in traffic toward the cluster.
